prompt:
Check one candidate model relation against the source sentences of a long document. The sentences come from different places in the document; unit ids show their order.

Candidate: Common Situation Display provides "Calculated Takeoff Time and Target Off Block Time" to Collaborative Decision Log (an information or material flow).

Source sentences:
S368: In a Capacity Reduction State, the Airport Duty Manager and Tower Supervisor agree whether the metering horizon should be extended so that delay is absorbed before pushback rather than near the runway.
S369: All changes to Target Off Block Time values, Calculated Takeoff Time values, and threshold overrides are written to the Collaborative Decision Log and Audit Event Ledger.
S684: The Flight Data Exchange publishes revised Flight Intent Message content only after the approved substitution is final and time synchronized.
S685: The Common Situation Display presents the updated Calculated Takeoff Time and Target Off Block Time so that operational users share the same view of the accepted change.

Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Common Situation Display produces or sends this item AND that Collaborative Decision Log receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). Answer "unsupported" if they describe different items, the wrong elements or the opposite direction. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"S685 says the Common Situation Display presents the updated times to users, and S369 says changes are written to the Collaborative Decision Log, but no sentence says the Display sends these values to the Log, so the flow from Display to Log is not stated."}
